children: Eurozone bond yields extended their rise with the 10-year German Bund yield hitting another 15-year high after the European Central Bank's well-anticipated quarter-point rate hike and upward revision of inflation for 2027 and 2028. The 10-year Bund yield--which had climbed to successive 15-year highs this session even before the ECB's decision--last trades 3.6 basis points higher at 3.464%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
